title: The Lantern of Shonar Bagan

characters.name: Rokeya
characters.description: A 19-year-old apprentice lantern-keeper: short black hair tied back with a red thread, a patched olive-green shawl over a plain kurta, sharp watchful eyes, and a brass lantern that never leaves her hand.

characters.name: Ishaan
characters.description: A tired but gentle clockmaker in his fifties: silver-streaked beard, round spectacles, a brown waistcoat over rolled-up sleeves, and ink-stained fingers.

story_text: In the riverside town of Shonar Bagan the lamps go out at midnight, and nobody has ever asked why. Rokeya, a nineteen-year-old apprentice lantern-keeper, has carried the same brass lantern up the same four hundred steps every evening for two years. Tonight the flame leans sideways, as if something on the hill is breathing. At the top she finds the old clockmaker Ishaan standing in the dark with his hands empty. "The tower stopped nine days ago," he says quietly. "I have been climbing up here every night since, trying to remember how to wind it." Rokeya holds the lantern higher. Behind the clock face, something enormous shifts, and a single warm eye opens in the brass. Ishaan whispers a name she has never heard. For the first time in nine nights, the town below holds its breath and waits to see if the light comes back.
